title: 第263章 看来自己充的还是不够多第262章 你不要过来啊
content_zh:
第263章看来自己充的还是不够多！
“……”
再次点亮一张“启光符”，将这片深海照的通明。
然后云阳就看到一个COS杨过的夜叉在海水中四仰八叉的漂浮着。
气息平稳，但表情好像极为痛苦。
这是……吓晕过去了？
真的假的？
可以说从筑基开始，不管是修什么的，其存在都已经可以称得上和“生物”这两个字没什么关系了。
就这还能被吓晕？
这什么心理素质啊？
这还能叫元婴？
想了一下，觉得不对的云阳张开手掌，一把摁在这独臂夜叉的脸上。
但在这个时候，一直没动静的独臂夜叉突然就睁大了双眼，“等等！其实我……”
6，为了活命，连装晕这种比慌不择路还饥不择食的办法也用出来了吗？
“砰！”
云阳却没有理会，直接一巴掌给他脑袋摁爆了。
但夜叉的元婴却像是蓄谋已久般，在其脑袋被捏爆的一瞬间，这缕元婴却趁机爆发出了惊人的速度，想从云阳的指尖溜走。
可……如果状态全开的情况下还能让其逃遁，那这么多钱岂不就白充了？
掌中的镇压之力微微一动，空间随即扭转，一时间，仿佛天地倒转般，刚刚还一瞬间便遁离几公里的夜叉元婴，恍惚间突然发现自己又重新出现在云阳的掌中了。
“等！等一下！”独臂夜叉的元婴生怕云阳直接给他捏爆，连忙传音说道：“你就不想知道我夜叉一族究竟是为什么被镇压于此吗？我告诉你！这关乎到一件你想象不到的大机缘，只要你放了我，我就！”

“砰！”
没有丝毫犹豫，云阳直接就给他捏爆了。
开玩笑，机缘？
怎么？这难道是很稀有的东西吗？
“呼~”
云阳薅了把已经披散开的长发，长呼出一口气。
完事！
杀爽了。
开无双确实开爽了。
从变强以来，自己还没火力全开的输出过，刚刚这波开无双，就突然有种久不运动，突然打了场酣畅淋漓的运动比赛的感觉。
畅快！
就是畅快的有点血腥。
content_en:
Chapter 263 It seems that I haven’t charged enough!
"..."
Light up a "Light Enlightenment Talisman" again to illuminate the deep sea.
Then Yunyang saw a COS Yang Guo's Yaksha floating in the sea.
His breathing was steady, but his expression seemed extremely painful.
Is this... fainting from fright?
Real or fake?
It can be said that from the beginning of foundation building, no matter what it is built, its existence can be said to have nothing to do with the word "biological".
Can you still be stunned by this?
What kind of psychological quality is this?
Can this still be called Nascent Soul?
After thinking for a moment, Yunyang felt that something was wrong and opened his palms to press the one-armed Yaksha on the face.
But at this moment, the one-armed Yaksha, who had been silent all this time, suddenly opened his eyes wide, "Wait! Actually, I..."
6. In order to survive, did you even resort to pretending to be stunned, which is more desperate than panicking?
"Bang!"
Yunyang ignored him and slapped him on the head.
But Yasha's Nascent Soul seemed to have been planned for a long time. At the moment when his head was crushed, this ray of Nascent Soul took the opportunity to burst out at an astonishing speed, trying to slip away from Yunyang's fingertips.
But... if he can escape even when his status is fully activated, wouldn't all that money be in vain?
The suppressive power in the palm moved slightly, and the space immediately reversed. For a moment, it was as if the world was turned upside down. Yasha Nascent Soul, who had escaped several kilometers away just for a moment, suddenly found himself reappearing in Yunyang's palm.
"Wait! Wait a minute!" The one-armed Yaksha Nascent Soul was afraid that Yunyang would crush him, so he quickly sent a message and said: "Don't you want to know why my Yaksha clan was suppressed here? Let me tell you! This is related to a great opportunity that you can't imagine. As long as you let me go, I will!"
"Bang!"
Without any hesitation, Yunyang crushed him.
Are you kidding, chance?
how? Is this a very rare thing?
"Huh~"
Yunyang pulled back his long hair that had been spread out and took a long breath.
Done!
It's great to kill.
It’s really fun to open Wushuang.
Ever since I became stronger, I have never been able to output with full firepower. Just after this wave of unparalleled power, I suddenly felt as if I had not exercised for a long time and suddenly played a hearty sports game.
carefree!
It's just fun and a little bloody.
